title: Hacienda Sereda

services.name: The Ballroom
services.desc: Each event is unique and guest occupancy may differ depending set up and event type. A step through arched wooden double doors from the Inner Courtyard you will enter The Ballroom. What makes this room grand is the elaborate focal floor to ceiling fireplace, and what would a grand room be without the additional wooden planked cathedral ceiling. The Ballroom is also adjacent to The Bar for easy flow and access should you require for your event. This space can be used for: Weddings, Social Events, Corporate Events, Awards Ceremonies, Staff Appreciation, Galas, Seminars/Training, Launch Parties, Recitals, and
